body:
I don't fully understand the update issue you're having. Could you explain the steps to reproduce that issue?

The string/array issue _should_ be solved already, as it was fixed in 4bc05ff96fab36bb5c8f337f82143d02311f0c48.

Calling `Form->create('members._ids')` doesn't sound right at all. Are you sure you're not calling input() instead?

Sorry my typo mistake ;-)

Yes I using input not create,  and the problem is in the controller when I need set ('_ids',$members) to all HATMB in the form, without the model prefix

about the update error

1 create a form with hatbm and multiple select
2  save the first time, save fine
3 edit the same record and deselect one option on the select, then you got the above mentioned errors

Thanks for giving the steps, I'll give them a try tonight. Instead of relying on the magic variable guessing you can/should use something like `input('members._ids', ['options' => $members]);` instead.

For me, both create and update do not work. No errors either

Input looks like:
echo $this->Form->input('users.$users', ['options' => $users]);

Users are nicely shown in a multiple select, the save or update goes well, but not for the HABTM relations, no data is saved and no errors are generated. 

Models (Users and Businesses):

```
    $this->belongsToMany('Businesses', [
        'foreignKey' => 'user_id',
        'targetForeignKey' => 'business_id',
        'joinTable' => 'businesses_users',
    ]);

    $this->belongsToMany('Users', [
        'foreignKey' => 'business_id',
        'targetForeignKey' => 'user_id',
        'joinTable' => 'businesses_users',
    ]);
```

@NoobsAllowed `echo $this->Form->input('users.$users');` is not something cakephp recognises. It should just be `echo $this->Form->input('users', ['options' => $users])`; or `echo $this->Form->input('users._ids', ['options' => $users])`
@lorenzo. echo $this->Form->input('users.$users'); comes default with a HABTM Cake Bake. I have tried the other options, no HABTM data is saved (no error).
That's an error in the bake templates, then. I will investigate it and fix ti soon

Not sure what went wrong there, I have baked it last week, did not change any code. 

Are you able to save and edit any HABTM data? If yes, could you please share your view, controller and model code? I can't get it to work out of the box.
Saving an empty set of belongsToMany association data doesn't work for me locally, I'll look into fixing it.

issue.body:
Fix several issues related to saving belongsToMany associations. I checked the following things manually and added additional test coverage for:
- Removing all associations.
- Adding associations.
- Removing all but one.
- Creating a new record with no belongsToMany links.

This set of changes resolves #3485.
